doc: Rebirth/Documentation/research/RE-cart-climb-seats.md (sections 1, 4, 5, both builds side by side; the decompiles in research/.ida-mcp/cartjump/; the slots and bytes read from both exes)

facts.name: vt_AEndFieldActionCartJumpActor
facts.note: The pass CARTJUMP: the class's native vtable (the Blueprint SampleCartDoubleJump00 keeps it); its trigger slot holds the shared enter in both exes; the actor slots at or above +0x400 sit +8 from 1.004.

facts.name: CartJump_Vt728_Unregister
facts.note: The leader's unregister from its controller list, then ParkourList_RemoveAll for the cart, then the marker off; at vt+0x728 / +0x730.

facts.name: CartJump_Vt748_Notify
facts.note: (actor, context): busy, can-act (the leader's state and the primary pawn), ordinary movement and approach (the primary pawn's stick) tests; ParkourList_AddUnique on a pass in climb mode, ParkourList_RemoveAll on a fail.

facts.name: slot: CartJump follower enter (1.004 vt+0x6B0, 1.005 vt+0x6B8)
CartJump_Vt6B0_AIEnter_RequestJump
facts.note: (actor, character): bOnlyUsePlayer clear, a target cart and the side check, then the jump state requested on the follower.

facts.name: ParkourList_AddUnique_Global3C0
facts.note: (actor): under the list lock, TArray<FWeakObjectPtr>::AddUnique on FieldActionGlobal+0x3C0, then a stale-entry prune. 1.004 entry %16=C (the first instruction crosses: the redirect at the second, 48 89 6C 24 20), 1.005 %16=4 (fits).

facts.name: ParkourList_RemoveAll_Global3C0
facts.note: (actor): under the list lock, RemoveAll of the cart's weak entries, then the prune. Entry %16=0 / %16=4: fits.

facts.name: CartJump_Vt748_Notify's ParkourList_AddUnique call
facts.note: E8 F9 FC 6C 00 / E8 BD CA 6F 00; the mod knows the notify's add by this call's return address (checked as an E8 to the add at install).

facts.name: CartJump_Vt748_Notify's ParkourList_RemoveAll call
facts.note: E8 08 43 6D 00 / E8 78 E2 4E FE; as above.

facts.name: CartJump_Vt728_Unregister's ParkourList_RemoveAll call
facts.note: E8 E8 44 6D 00 / E8 58 E4 4E FE; as above.
